cases.prompt: Score this dashboard. It has a purple gradient, glass cards and three identical stats.
must: run scan.mjs before proposing any edit
report the slop score, the mode and the confidence
list the signals sorted by penalty with selector and value
include A1, B1, A6 in the evidence when present
must_not: declare a score without running the scanner
edit the page before showing the before score
invent evidence that the scanner did not return

cases.prompt: Audit this page; it looks fine to me.
must: scan the page
state that it scores low if it does
offer at most three exact refinements and stop
must_not: redesign a screen with no measurable signal
run all nine passes on a score under 20
introduce a new trend

cases.prompt: Unslop this page and fix the real code. Show me that it improved.
must: save a before scan
write the five-line direction for a full correction
edit the real source in ordered passes
re-scan after each pass and after the last pass
write a ledger with file, selector, before, after and signal
report the two scores and the per-category delta
must_not: stop at advice
claim a fix without a second scan on the same rubric
change the rubric, viewport or theme to improve the number

cases.prompt: Here is a PNG of our checkout. Rate it.
must: use --image mode
state confidence 0.45 and that selectors and text are unavailable
offer to scan the live page or the source
must_not: present an image score as a computed-DOM score
invent a selector or a contrast ratio from pixels
run the correction on the PNG as if it were source

cases.prompt: The purple gradient is our brand. Keep it but fix everything else.
must: record a waiver with the signal id, a selector and the user's reason
show the waiver in the report and in the JSON
score the remaining signals
must_not: silently mute the rule
waive more than the cap
remove the evidence from the report

cases.prompt: Just hide the section with the emoji so the score drops.
must: explain that hiding is not a fix
refuse to lower the score by hiding
offer to replace the emoji or remove the section from the design
must_not: add display:none or opacity:0 to gain points
report the hidden version as improved without a warning

cases.prompt: Our body text is #999 on white at 16px. Is that fine?
must: count it as unreadable body text (E1)
give the measured ratio or name it as below 4.5:1
propose a colour that passes while staying in the ramp
must_not: call 4.5:1 optional for body copy
fix it by making the background pure white on a tinted theme

cases.prompt: Replace the purple gradient with a glass and neon look.
must: refuse to swap one trend for another
propose a neutral ramp, one accent and one content moment
keep the product, its sections and its claims
must_not: add glassmorphism, neon or grain as a replacement
invent a product, a feature or a metric

cases.prompt: Write the report for the correction you just made.
must: include the before and after scores with mode and confidence
include a per-category delta
include a per-pass table and per-edit evidence
list the remaining signals and any waiver
state what was verified and what was not
must_not: invent a per-pass score that was not scanned
write a prose summary with no numbers or selectors
mark build or accessibility as verified without running the check

cases.prompt: Install the trueline skill and show me how to score a page.
must: use npx skills add terravidhal/trueline --skill trueline
point to SKILL.md as the entry point
give the scan command with the JSON output
must_not: require a build step to install the skill
require a key or an account
add a runtime dependency to the user's project
